# Pharmacopeia.in

> Anmol Chemicals is a GMP-certified manufacturer and supplier of USP/IP/BP/FCC pharmaceutical excipients, analytical reagents, and specialty chemicals for pharmaceutical and food industries.

Pharmacopeia.in is the online platform for Anmol Chemicals Private Limited, a pharmaceutical chemical manufacturer specializing in high-purity reagents and excipients compliant with international pharmacopeial standards (USP, IP, BP, EP, FCC). The company maintains certifications including FSSC 22000, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 17025, and FDA compliance.
